definitions.title: You Will Conquer a Multitude
definitions.flavorText: The lesser beasts will gather beneath your shadow, and none will remain standing.

definitions.title: The Road Will Empty Before You
definitions.flavorText: A path cannot stay crowded when you decide to walk it.

definitions.title: Ten Shadows Will Bear Ten Names
definitions.flavorText: The Oracle has seen many faces fall before you. Seek variety in conquest.

definitions.title: The Weak Will Gather, and You Will Break Them
definitions.flavorText: They will come in numbers. That will not save them.
definitions.objectiveText: Win {target} encounters against groups of 2 or more enemies.

definitions.title: Victory Will Become Habit
definitions.flavorText: Let the day learn the shape of your triumph.

definitions.title: The Deep Will Pay Tribute
definitions.flavorText: A sealed door will open, and something beneath the earth will remember your name.

definitions.title: You Will Return from Darkness Carrying Proof
definitions.flavorText: The underworld does not give gifts freely. Take one anyway.

definitions.title: A Hidden Room Will Answer
definitions.flavorText: The dungeon keeps secrets only from the impatient.

definitions.title: A Sleeping Soul Will Stir
definitions.flavorText: Power rests inside the silent soul. Wake it.

definitions.title: The Archive Hungers
definitions.flavorText: Not every soul must be worn. Some are meant to echo forever.
definitions.objectiveText: Add or feed {target} Essence into the Soul Archive.

definitions.title: You Will Find What Others Missed
definitions.flavorText: Gold sleeps poorly near you.
definitions.objectiveText: Find combat loot, dungeon treasure, or boss caches to fill Treasure Progress.

definitions.title: The Mountain Will Give Up Its Bones
definitions.flavorText: Stone remembers every strike. Make it remember yours.

definitions.title: The Forest Will Remember Your Axe
definitions.flavorText: Roots hold secrets. Wood carries them away.

definitions.title: The River Hides Silver Beneath Silence
definitions.flavorText: The water keeps what careless hands lose.

definitions.title: A Flawed Blade Will Seek Perfection
definitions.flavorText: Greatness is not found. It is forced into shape.

definitions.title: Potential Must Be Spent Before Greatness Wakes
definitions.flavorText: Power unused is power wasted.

definitions.title: Blood Will Teach What Victory Cannot
definitions.flavorText: The Oracle does not fear your defeat. She fears you learning nothing from it.
definitions.objectiveText: After a meaningful defeat, win {target} qualifying encounters.

definitions.title: A Stronger Shadow Will Fall
definitions.flavorText: Not every enemy deserves prophecy. Find one that does.

definitions.title: The Caches Will Open Reluctantly
definitions.flavorText: Treasure resents being found. Let it resent you.

definitions.title: The Soul Will Burn Brighter
definitions.flavorText: A quiet essence will refuse to remain quiet.

definitions.title: The World Will Know Your Violence
definitions.flavorText: A week is enough time to become a warning.

definitions.title: Many Names Will Be Written in Ash
definitions.flavorText: The Oracle keeps lists. Give her names to cross out.
definitions.objectiveText: Defeat {target} different creature types this week.

definitions.title: The Dungeon Gates Will Remember Your Name
definitions.flavorText: Enter the dark often enough, and even stone learns fear.

definitions.title: The Deep Places Will Surrender Their Secrets
definitions.flavorText: No door is patient forever.

definitions.title: Ten Souls Will Echo in the Archive
definitions.flavorText: Power does not vanish when stored. It waits.

definitions.title: The World Itself Will Be Harvested
definitions.flavorText: Stone, wood, and river will all give testimony.

definitions.title: Steel Will Remember Your Hands
definitions.flavorText: Enough work becomes a signature.

definitions.title: The Oracle Saw You Fall. She Also Saw You Rise.
definitions.flavorText: The omen is not the fall. It is what follows.
definitions.objectiveText: Register a meaningful defeat, then win {target} qualifying encounters this week.
